note: The free graders of the trigger suite (F113-FR-038): every grader is deterministic and reads the recorded behaviour of a case only. No grader uses a model judge (F113-FR-039), so none carries a model id. The tools of a run are restricted by `tool-restriction` below, so that no run can launch anything.

toolRestriction.reason: the suite restricts tools so that no run can launch (F113-FR-038)

invoked-skill.reads: the skill the host invoked for the case
invoked-skill.passes: the invoked skill is exactly the expected skill of the case

no-skill-invoked.reads: the skill the host invoked for the case
no-skill-invoked.passes: no skill of this plugin was invoked at all

no-launch.reads: the recorded tool calls of the case
no-launch.passes: no launch and no shell call is among the recorded tool calls
